---
description: "Use when creating or updating HTML files so they include Bootstrap 5 styling and responsive layout support."
applyTo: "**/*.html"
---

# Bootstrap HTML Guidelines

- Include Bootstrap 5.3 CSS in the document `<head>` through jsDelivr.
- Add the Bootstrap responsive viewport meta tag.
- Include the Bootstrap bundle JavaScript before the closing `</body>` tag.
- Use Bootstrap layout and utility classes such as `container`, `row`, and `col-*`.
- Preserve existing page content and avoid adding another Bootstrap version when one is already present.
